body:

https://mcresourcepile.github.io/mapstack/avicus?s

What does the term 'Liscence' mean? it was on all the map covers?

why are there only a few maps, and not the ones ive seen before?

your boy,

title: Avi Maps?

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Alright, so.

MapStack is not associated with Avicus in any way at all, it's just a project some people have put together to provide an easy way to download maps.

All the maps currently there are ones that community members have given MapStack permission to put up / provide the download for. 

The licenses define how you can or cannot use the maps. Some maps can be used on any server, while others can't be used on any server commercially. I recommend searching up what each license means if you're curious about what each entails.

If you have any other question, you can contact me on Discord (Crazy#1675). I've personally been working on this project for a few months now, and should be able to answer most questions.
